sources.note: Main website. All-in-one behavioral health EHR and practice management. 8M+ claims, 14M+ appointments, 805K assessments. $49/month pricing. Targets psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists, social workers, addiction specialists.
ONC certification page listing 30 certified modules. DrFirst/Rcopia e-prescribing integration. Direct messaging included. Monthly subscription pricing by clinician seat.
Clinical documentation features: smart note prepopulation, automated billing from documents, batch generation for group/family sessions, customizable documents, supervisor signing workflows.
Product overview page. AI-powered session summaries, digital front door, teletherapy for up to 6 participants, NC-Connex, MIPS/MACRA reporting, eCQM. $49 base + $75+$40/mo for e-prescribing.

Practice management features: calendar management, patient self-scheduling, fax from EHR, supervisor relationship management, data migration, extensive clinical/financial/demographic/quality reporting, multiple locations, unlimited users.
Integrated CPT coding with compliance updates, revenue cycle management, claim error identification.

MBC features: automated weekly assessments, 20+ adult instruments (GAD-7, PHQ-9, OQ-45, etc.), child instruments (YOQ, SCARED), special populations (EPDS, eating disorders). Customizable batteries, aggregate reporting at clinician/program/clinic level.
Patient portal: pay invoices, view/sign documents, secure messaging, teletherapy access, appointment scheduling, assessment completion.
HIPAA-compliant teletherapy built into EHR. Launched from patient chart. Desktop, iOS, Android. No details on session recording/storage.
CarePaths Connect mobile app. Tracks anxiety, depression, wellbeing, loneliness, medication adherence, therapist confidence. Secure messaging, teletherapy, scheduling, assessments.
Company history article. Over two decades of experience. Barrett Griffith named CEO after 3 years as CTO. Digital-first pivot. Launch of CarePaths Connect app.
FindEMR listing. 2 reviews. Users praise note templates and affordability. Criticisms: learning curve, customer support quality. Practices with 1-50 employees.
